visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of a modern, minimalist room featuring light wood flooring and ceiling. Large floor-to-ceiling windows offer a panoramic view of the Gwangandaegyo Bridge and the sea under an overcast sky. A large wooden soaking tub is positioned near the window. (2) Inside, a woman with dark hair wearing a blue cardigan and denim skirt is seen relaxing on a curved beige sofa. She stretches her arms wide, smiling at the camera. Behind her is a clean, open-plan kitchen with wooden shelving and white tiles. (3) A sequence of shots showcases the room's interior: a framed painting of a ceramic jar, a traditional low table with a white tea set, and various wooden furniture pieces. (4) The camera shifts to an outdoor view of Gwangalli Beach, showing the sandy shore, white umbrellas, and the urban skyline with high-rise buildings. (5) Night footage reveals the bridge illuminated with colorful rainbow lights, followed by a vibrant fireworks display over the water. (6) Detailed shots of the amenities include a wooden drawer being opened to reveal organized cutlery, a sleek bathroom with a circular mirror where the woman takes a selfie, and a minimalist bedroom with a white bed and a burnt-orange accent wall. (7) A man with a backpack is shown pressing an elevator button in a hallway. The video concludes with a shot of the woman in the bathroom mirror making a peace sign.
